tools.name: engine_status
tools.title: Engine status
tools.description: Report the engine build, CPU features, thread count, workspace location and the datasets it holds. Call this first to check the environment.

tools.name: simulate_dataset
tools.title: Simulate a planted-structure dataset
tools.description: Create a synthetic count matrix with known cell types and a low-rank continuum, written to the block format. Use it to test workflows and to benchmark: the true labels are stored as 'truth/labels'.

tools.name: import_matrix
tools.title: Import a count matrix
tools.description: Convert a Matrix Market (.mtx/.mtx.gz), SciPy sparse (.npz) or an existing block file into the workspace. Counts must be non-negative integers below 65536.

tools.name: describe_dataset
tools.title: Describe a dataset
tools.description: Cheap structural summary: size, block layout, density, estimated memory and time for the common steps, and the arrays already computed.

tools.name: qc_summary
tools.title: Per-cell QC and gene statistics
tools.description: One streaming pass: total counts, detected genes and percent counts in flagged (mitochondrial) genes per cell, plus per-gene moments. Reports quantiles, MAD-based outlier counts and histograms; stores per-cell arrays.

tools.name: select_hvg
tools.title: Highly variable genes
tools.description: Select highly variable genes by the Seurat dispersion method from the streaming gene moments (matches Scanpy's top-n selection). Stores a mask used by pca and nmf_programs.

tools.name: pca
tools.title: Streaming PCA
tools.description: Block-Krylov PCA of log1p(CP10k) values streamed from disk, with Rayleigh-Ritz extraction after every pass and Ritz-residual stopping. Memory does not grow with cells. Stores scores, loadings and singular values.

tools.name: choose_n_pcs
tools.title: Choose the number of PCs
tools.description: Recommend how many principal components to keep from the spectrum: elbow, cumulative variance and a random-matrix noise edge, with the evidence for each.

tools.name: knn_graph
tools.title: k-nearest-neighbour graph
tools.description: Neighbour graph on PCA scores. Exact blocked search up to a size limit, grouped IVF above it, always with a recall check against exact search on a random sample of cells.

tools.name: cluster
tools.title: Cluster cells (Louvain)
tools.description: Louvain modularity clustering on the kNN graph (shared-nearest-neighbour or plain connectivity weights). Stores labels; reports sizes, modularity and agreement with truth labels if the dataset has them.

tools.name: scan_resolution
tools.title: Scan clustering resolutions
tools.description: Run Louvain over a list of resolutions with two seeds each and report the number of clusters, modularity and seed-to-seed stability (ARI), so the resolution can be chosen from evidence rather than by default.

tools.name: embed_umap
tools.title: 2-D embedding (UMAP-class)
tools.description: Fuzzy-graph layout optimised by multithreaded SGD, initialised from scaled PCA scores. Reports how well 2-D neighbours match the high-dimensional graph.

tools.name: nmf_programs
tools.title: Gene programs by NMF
tools.description: Streaming alternating-least-squares NMF of log1p(CP10k): one pass per iteration, state independent of the number of cells. Returns the top genes of each program and the loss curve.

tools.name: gsea_prerank
tools.title: Preranked gene-set enrichment
tools.description: Weighted-KS enrichment score for each gene set on a ranked gene list, with a size-matched permutation null (exact scores, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR). Provide the ranking inline or point at an NMF program.

tools.name: compare_labelings
tools.title: Compare two labelings
tools.description: Agreement between two stored label arrays: ARI, the contingency of the largest groups and per-cluster purity. Use it to compare clusterings, or a clustering with planted truth.

tools.name: plot_scatter
tools.title: Scatter plot of two stored arrays
tools.description: Scatter of two stored arrays or columns (for example 'embedding/umap[0]' vs 'embedding/umap[1]') coloured by a stored label array. Returns the SVG path and a text description with cluster centroids.

tools.name: plot_histogram
tools.title: Histogram of a stored array
tools.description: Histogram of a stored array or column with quantiles and optional vertical threshold lines.

tools.name: inspect_artifact
tools.title: Inspect a stored array
tools.description: Debug view of any stored array: shape, dtype, finite fraction, quantiles, a small head, and for label arrays the group counts. Use it to check an intermediate result before the next step.

tools.name: provenance
tools.title: Run history of a dataset
tools.description: Chronological list of the tools run on a dataset with parameters, key metrics and timings, for auditing and reproducing an analysis.

tools.name: report
tools.title: Assemble an analysis report
tools.description: Build a single HTML or Markdown report from the recorded steps of a dataset: every summary, metric table and figure, in order. Returns the file path.

tools.name: standard_workflow
tools.title: Standard workflow in one call
tools.description: QC, HVG, PCA, neighbour graph, clustering and 2-D embedding in a single call (each step is one compiled streaming pass or kernel), then a report. Use it for a first look; use the individual tools to tune.

tools.name: selftest
tools.title: Engine self-test and timing
tools.description: Run correctness checks against NumPy references and short timings on a small simulated dataset (a few seconds). Run it after building on a new machine or cluster node, before trusting large runs.
